verdict.rationale: FreshBooks documents double-entry accounting with a customizable chart of accounts, journal entries, and "detailed financial reports" that the founder or accountant can run, plus a Reports API exposing seven report types. That is a plausible foundation for financial statements, but none of the cited material names a P&L, balance sheet, or cash-flow statement, and the listed API reports are operational (Invoice Details, Payments Collected). Missing for 10: explicit evidence of P&L, balance sheet, and cash-flow statement reports, custom/any-period date ranges, on-demand generation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of accuracy.
